result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly impacted by an elevated rail structure that creates deep shadows and substantial visual obstructions at the intersection corners. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and crosswalks are present, they are poorly maintained with faded markings and narrow clearances around structural pillars.

hazards.name: Structural Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large steel pillars for the elevated rail structure are located at the intersection corners, blocking sightlines between turning drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left foreground at the intersection corners

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Low Visibility Environment
hazards.description: The overhead rail structure creates a dark, shadowed environment that reduces the contrast and visibility of pedestrians even during daylight hours.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire intersection area under the elevated tracks

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to move pedestrians past the visual obstruction of the pillars and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add supplemental lighting underneath the rail structure specifically aimed at the sidewalks and crosswalks to mitigate shadows.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is heavily impacted by an elevated transit structure that creates significant visual obstructions and a shadowed roadway. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the structural columns and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals create a challenging environment for safe navigation.

hazards.name: Structural Column Obstructions
hazards.description: Large steel columns supporting the elevated track block sightlines between motorists and pedestrians at the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right-side curb line and sidewalk area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to move pedestrians into a more visible position beyond the structural columns before they begin crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting specifically directed at the crosswalk and sidewalk areas beneath the elevated tracks to improve visibility.

result.summary: This urban intersection is located beneath an elevated transit structure, which creates significant visual obstructions for both pedestrians and drivers due to large support pillars. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks, traffic signals, and marked crosswalks are present, the environment is cluttered and the pavement markings are noticeably faded.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Elevated Structure
hazards.description: Large steel pillars supporting the elevated train tracks block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the pedestrian crossing area less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Clutter
hazards.description: Poles, fire hydrants, and transit infrastructure narrow the effective walking width on the sidewalk corners.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the pillars.

interventions.title: Improved Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Enhance lighting beneath the elevated tracks to improve visibility for all road users in the shadowed area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is heavily impacted by a large elevated rail structure that creates significant visual obstructions and deep shadows across the wide roadway. While sidewalks and basic traffic signals are present, the lack of high-visibility crossing infrastructure and the presence of massive support pillars in the sightlines create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Infrastructure
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the elevated rail structure create significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to spend a long time exposed to traffic without a refuge island or median.

hazards.name: Poor Lighting and Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure casts deep shadows that reduce the visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic, especially near the pillars.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area underneath the elevated tracks
